alt: 孩子手裡已拿到一塊餅乾，卻貪心地伸手想拿走大人的整盒餅乾。
scene_prompt: At a picnic table an adult has generously offered a child one biscuit which already rests in the child’s first hand. Instead of being satisfied, the child greedily reaches with the other hand for the adult’s entire large tin of biscuits, eager insistent expression; the adult looks surprised and draws the tin slightly back. Clear escalation from a small granted favor to demanding much more, no ruler or measuring.
